name: list_automod_rules
description: Lists AutoMod rules in the guild.

name: create_automod_rule
description: Creates a mention-spam, keyword-preset, or member-profile AutoMod rule.

name: edit_automod_rule
description: Enables, disables, or renames an existing AutoMod rule.

name: create_keyword_rule
description: Creates an AutoMod keyword block rule.

name: delete_automod_rule
description: Deletes an AutoMod rule by ID.

name: get_audit_log
description: Reads the Discord audit log with optional limit, actor, and action filters; this is Discord telemetry, not the bot's prompt-audit database.

name: prune_members
description: Previews or executes pruning inactive members; execute=true is destructive and requires confirmation.

name: set_bot_presence
description: Sets the bot's Discord status and optional playing activity.

name: create_channel
description: Creates a new text, voice, category, or forum channel.

name: delete_channel
description: Deletes a channel from the guild.

name: edit_channel
description: Edits properties of a channel such as name, topic, or nsfw flag.

name: rename_channel
description: Renames a channel.

name: set_topic
description: Sets a text channel topic (empty clears it).

name: set_slowmode
description: Sets slowmode delay in seconds on a text channel (0 disables).

name: lock_channel
description: Locks a channel by denying Send Messages for @everyone.

name: unlock_channel
description: Unlocks a channel by resetting the @everyone Send Messages overwrite to neutral.

name: move_channel
description: Moves a channel to a new position and/or category.

name: set_channel_permissions
description: Sets a permission overwrite for a role/member on a channel.

target_id.description: Role or member ID for the overwrite
target_id.title: Target Id

name: delete_channel_permission
description: Deletes a role or member permission overwrite from a channel.

name: list_emojis
description: Lists custom emojis in the guild.

name: edit_emoji
description: Renames a custom guild emoji.

name: create_emoji
description: Creates a custom emoji from base64 image data.

name: delete_emoji
description: Deletes a custom emoji by ID.

name: create_scheduled_event
description: Creates a scheduled event (voice if channel_id given, else external).

name: edit_scheduled_event
description: Edits a scheduled event's name, description, time, or channel.

name: list_scheduled_event_users
description: Lists users interested in a scheduled event.

name: list_scheduled_events
description: Lists scheduled events in the guild.

name: delete_scheduled_event
description: Deletes a scheduled event by ID.

name: create_forum_post
description: Creates a forum post with initial content and optional applied forum tags.

name: list_forum_tags
description: Lists available tags for a forum channel.

name: set_forum_tags
description: Replaces the applied tags on a forum post.

name: add_thread_member
description: Adds a user to or from a Discord thread by ID.

name: remove_thread_member
description: Removes a user to or from a Discord thread by ID.

name: get_guild_info
description: Returns basic guild info: name, member/channel/role counts.

name: get_welcome_screen
description: Reads the guild welcome screen and configured welcome channels.

name: edit_welcome_screen
description: Edits the guild welcome screen description or enabled state.

name: get_onboarding
description: Reads guild onboarding settings and prompts.

name: edit_onboarding
description: Enables or disables guild onboarding while preserving its existing prompts and default channels.

name: get_widget
description: Reads the guild widget enabled state and channel.

name: edit_widget
description: Edits guild widget visibility and optional widget channel.

name: get_vanity_url
description: Reads the guild vanity invite when the guild is eligible for one.

name: list_integrations
description: Lists guild integrations such as Twitch or YouTube connections.

name: list_templates
description: Lists server templates associated with the guild.

name: create_template
description: Creates a reusable server template from the current guild.

name: sync_template
description: Syncs a Discord server template with the current guild.

name: delete_template
description: Deletes a Discord server template by template code.

name: edit_guild
description: Edits guild name and/or description.

name: list_bans
description: Lists banned users in the guild.

name: create_invite
description: Creates a server invite for a channel (max_age/max_uses 0 = unlimited).

name: list_invites
description: Lists active server invites.

name: delete_invite
description: Deletes a server invite by code.

name: timeout_member
description: Times out a member for a specified duration in seconds.

name: untimeout_member
description: Removes an active timeout from a member.

name: kick_member
description: Kicks a member from the guild (they can rejoin with a new invite).

name: ban_member
description: Bans a member from the guild.

name: unban_member
description: Unbans a user by ID so they can rejoin the guild.

name: set_nickname
description: Sets or clears a member nickname (empty nickname clears it).

name: move_member
description: Moves a member to a voice channel, or disconnects them when no channel is given.

name: mute_member
description: Server-mutes or unmutes a member in voice.

name: deafen_member
description: Server-deafens or undeafens a member in voice.

name: send_message
description: Sends a message to a channel. Optional embed_title/embed_description, reply_to_message_id, attachment_url, or sticker_id.

name: edit_message
description: Edits the content of a bot-sent message.

name: delete_message
description: Deletes a single message by ID.

name: pin_message
description: Pins a message in a text channel.

name: unpin_message
description: Unpins a message in a text channel.

name: purge_messages
description: Bulk-deletes recent messages (max 100, skips pinned and older-than-14d).

name: add_reaction
description: Adds an emoji reaction to a message.

name: fetch_history
description: Reads recent message history from a channel (up to 50).

name: clear_reactions
description: Removes all reactions from a message.

name: remove_reaction
description: Removes a reaction from a message (own reaction, or another user's with manage_messages).

name: create_poll
description: Creates a native Discord poll in a channel. duration_hours must be 1, 24, 72, or 168.

name: publish_message
description: Crossposts / publishes a message in an Announcement (news) channel.

name: create_role
description: Creates a new role in the server.

name: reorder_role
description: Moves a manageable role to a new role position.

name: assign_role
description: Assigns a role to a member.

name: delete_role
description: Deletes a role from the guild.

name: remove_role
description: Removes a role from a guild member.

name: edit_role
description: Edits a role name, color, hoist, or mentionable flag.

name: schedule_action
description: Schedules a Discord action once after delay_seconds (5s-30d) or on a cron expression. Dangerous actions needing confirmation can't be scheduled.

name: list_schedules
description: Lists active scheduled (delayed/cron) actions for this server.

name: cancel_schedule
description: Cancels a scheduled action by ID.

name: list_soundboard_sounds
description: Lists custom and default soundboard sounds visible to the guild.

name: create_soundboard_sound
description: Creates a bounded custom soundboard sound; does not connect to voice or play audio streams.

sound_base64.description: MP3/OGG sound bytes, base64 encoded, max 512KB
sound_base64.title: Sound Base64

name: delete_soundboard_sound
description: Deletes a custom soundboard sound by ID.

name: send_soundboard_sound
description: Triggers a soundboard effect in a voice channel without implementing voice playback.

name: start_stage
description: Starts a moderated Stage instance in a stage channel for an AMA, talk, or live event.

name: edit_stage
description: Updates the topic of the active Stage instance in a channel.

name: end_stage
description: Ends the active Stage instance in a stage channel.

name: list_stickers
description: Lists guild stickers available for sending or management.

name: create_sticker
description: Creates a guild sticker from bounded base64 image data.

name: delete_sticker
description: Deletes a guild sticker by ID.

name: create_thread
description: Creates a thread in a text channel, optionally attached to a message.

name: join_thread
description: Joins a thread as the bot.

name: leave_thread
description: Leaves a thread as the bot.

name: list_archived_threads
description: Lists archived threads under a text, announcement, forum, or media channel.

name: archive_thread
description: Archives or unarchives a thread.

name: list_active_threads
description: Lists active threads in the guild.

name: create_webhook
description: Creates a webhook in a text channel.

name: edit_webhook
description: Edits a webhook name or moves it to another channel.

name: execute_webhook
description: Executes a guild webhook with content or an embed. This can impersonate a webhook identity and always requires confirmation.

name: list_webhooks
description: Lists webhooks in the guild.

name: delete_webhook
description: Deletes a webhook by ID.
